files.description: Water gauge log (120 rows): gauge (gauge name such as "LA-01"), reading (meters, three decimals; about 3% empty), level (alert level, whole number from 3 to 80, no empty cells), site (dam, canal or lake; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Fill the gaps in the gauge log: a missing reading takes the reading of the previous row. Write this as a small function that fills the gaps of a table, and apply it to the log. `result` should be the filled log as a table with the same columns, in file order.
intended_computation: Forward-fill the 4 missing readings from the previous row and return all 120 rows and 4 columns in file order.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the function returns the None given back by the in-place fill; 3.x returns the filled table

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
